venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: Mellow shift. Light flow from 7pm, lull 8–9pm, then full bar and booths from 10pm to just past midnight. Almost all sales came in final two hours. MOD: MKZ/KG/JK Key.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: Slower-paced steady Thursday. Success with to-go ware early for outdoor weather. Many date-night guests staying 1–3 hours. Industry guests throughout. Kitchen ran smooth and clean. MOD: MD / JR & TY.

venues.name: Municipal Grand
venues.narrative: Above-target night. Great pre-show crowd (Lucas Theater show at 8pm), Sun Club and Hot Eye both busy. Hot Eye picked up strongly 10:30pm–midnight. Event on mezzanine was chill and lucrative. Police incident in restroom resolved quietly. MOD: James (evening) & Chef Shannon.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.weather: Chilly with a bit of wind
venues.narrative: Bar full beginning to end. Natalie found her flow on the floor. Most reservations were late but 98% of waitlist was accommodated. One table walkout but left $27. Strong vibe, many first-timers. MOD: Selenia & Chef Tomo.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: Decent night — steady busy throughout but never quite hit a wait. 6A/Garden busy all night. Sakura bar had great energy with Broken Promise and Salmon Dynamite as top hits. Smooth kitchen close. MOD: Evan & Chef Lucas.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: Stop-and-start service with busy pushes and slow gaps. Small waitlist kept flips smooth. Rangers game crowd in — one incident with an over-served guest managed professionally. Seth's first door training night. MOD: Courtney & Chef Ja.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: Slow start, picked up around 7pm with steady walk-ins and reservations. Room filled for a couple hours then quieted by 10:30pm. Garden closed. Trainees Savannah & Sasha helped on floor. Alexander Wang visited! MOD: Kevin/Cory.
